title: Add logging and platform-safe shutdown to MinecraftAdapter DisconnectAsync
description: Audit reports three silent `catch {}` blocks inside `Agent.World.Minecraft/MinecraftAdapter.cs` during process kill and disconnect sequences; on Windows `kill -TERM` always throws and the error is swallowed. Action: add `ILogger` usage, platform-safe process termination, and replace silent catches with `logger.LogWarning(ex, ...)`. Out-of-scope for Agent repo fixes here; assign to adapter maintainers.
